ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Corruption in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of corruption in Minnesota and follow the money trail to uncover any potential wrongdoing.
questions: What are the allegations of corruption in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a large-scale corruption scandal in Minnesota. By following the money trail and investigating the key players, we may be able to expose wrongdoing and bring those responsible to justice.
